posts.community: Frontier Springs - has departed, whats the next destination?
posts.text: IMHO market is looking for an answer to what next ? They promised 500 Cr. by FY26 in their first concall held in Nov’23 (~5x from FY23 levels). They have beautifully delivered so far and seem on track to meet their target for FY26. The business is now in steady state, but there are no visible answers to what can sustain the growth rate of last 2 years for next 2-3 years. FIBA revenue will be icing but may not help to sustain the growth rate which came from the introduction of Air springs. posts.community: Frontier Springs - has departed, whats the next destination?
posts.text: Expectations not met in Q1…….. The quarterly runrate is stagnant at 80cr. This was expected show a material upward trend towards 125cr, the base quarterly revenue to meet the 500cr guidance for the current year. Biz is however solid as ever, and the there seems no de growth in the railways capex, infact the underlying demand is strong with all optionalities of wagons, boogies, VB coaches and metro, all in expansion. Patience will be tested. Faith in the promoter is under review now. That’s how I see it…….. Disc…. Biased and invested
